title: Beylerbeyi event
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Beylerbeyi event", at revision 1358914676, opens: "Beylerbeyi event was a revolt in the Ottoman Empire in response to currency debasement in April 1589, during the reign of Murat III." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4899882, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1589 mutiny". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
